details: own_entry_port_l1_staging: copied op into perf_experiments/own_entry_port_l1_staging/agrn_stage; design: workers write own pages into a staging CB on the lane ports (walk order), per lane-bank counters (reused band global sems), port reader sends staged packets with no reads
relay/relay_u correct both sizes; mcast R20xW384 hangs on first call

QB2 1x4 ring is physically a 2x2 square: fwd router dirs per chip E,N,W,S (DPRINT). Straight mcast ranges of 2 cannot follow the ring (turn each hop) -> hang. Only N/S-first L paths expressible as 2D mcast.
host-computed physical route specs: straight or N/S-spine+E/W-branch L; each chip mcasts range 2 in its one expressible direction; readies as table-routed unicasts. LN size lands bit-exact.
op placement: focus relay 19.718 vs mcast 19.566 (flat); LN relay 10.679 vs mcast 9.152 (-1.53us). uniform placement costs +3.9us at focus (relay_u 23.60, mcast_u 23.94).
focus flat (19.72->19.55), LN win (10.68->9.10), 2KB slot regression (5.97->6.51, 2-hop ready fence). straight ranges inexpressible on QB2 square; Galaxy untested.

Port-core ingress ~30 GB/s many-to-one: 240 KB/port cannot beat DRAM 8-bank sinks. Next: distributed L1 staging (packet-ordered chunks on worker cores, 1 L1 read per chunk on the port)
